list.title: Relational Databases Explained: What, How, When, and Why
list.subheading: A practical guide to the relational model, SQL fundamentals, and the engineering decisions behind choosing a relational database
list.excerpt: Learn the core concepts of relational databases-tables, keys, normalization, ACID, and indexing-with practical SQL and code examples for engineers.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: SQL Design Patterns: What SOLID and the Gang of Four Teach Us About Schema and Query Design
list.subheading: Mapping object-oriented design principles onto relational database engineering
list.excerpt: How SOLID principles and Gang of Four design patterns translate into SQL schema and query design, with practical examples for engineers who think in both paradigms.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: SQLAlchemy Explained: What It Is, How It Works, and Why Python Developers Rely On It
list.subheading: A practical, no-nonsense introduction to Python's most widely used database toolkit - from Core expressions to ORM sessions
list.excerpt: A beginner-friendly deep dive into SQLAlchemy: what it is, how Core and ORM differ, and why it remains the standard for database work in Python.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Database Design Fundamentals for Web Developers
list.subheading: Master the Art of Building Scalable, Efficient Databases That Won't Come Back to Haunt You
list.excerpt: Learn database design fundamentals every web developer needs to know. From normalization to indexing strategies, discover how to build scalable databases that perform under pressure.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: SQLite Explained: What It Is, Why It Matters, and When to Use It
list.subheading: A practical guide to deciding between SQLite and a “full” database (Postgres/MySQL) for your next app.
list.excerpt: Learn what SQLite is, how it works, and when it's the best choice. This guide covers SQLite's strengths, limitations, common use cases, and how it compares to Postgres and MySQL.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Best Pagination Strategies for Large Datasets: A Developer's Decision Guide
list.subheading: Choose the right pagination approach based on data size, UX, and system constraints
list.excerpt: Learn proven pagination strategies for large datasets including offset, cursor, and keyset pagination with performance trade-offs and implementation examples.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Drizzle ORM Best Practices: Principles, Patterns, and Real-World Case Studies
list.subheading: Designing schemas, avoiding leaky abstractions, structuring repositories, and scaling from MVP to production.
list.excerpt: Discover Drizzle ORM best practices, from schema and migration principles to production-ready patterns, plus real-world project ideas and mini case studies you can replicate.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: ACID vs BASE: Foundations of Modern Data Consistency
list.subheading: How ACID and BASE Shape Reliability, Scalability, and Flexibility in Distributed Systems
list.excerpt: Explore the key differences between ACID and BASE models, and discover how these paradigms influence data integrity, consistency, and scalability in distributed architectures.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Choosing Between ACID and BASE: A Practical Guide for Architects
list.subheading: Decision Factors for Data Consistency Models in Scalable Systems
list.excerpt: Compare ACID vs BASE from a practical standpoint, and gain actionable insights on when to use each model for optimal consistency, availability, and partition tolerance.
list.author: Paul Serban
